recipes.name: Chicken souvlaki pittas
ingredients: 1 tsp dried oregano, 1 tsp smoked paprika
2 dl Turkish yoghurt, a little fresh dill
steps: Toss chicken with oil, oregano, paprika, lemon zest and half the juice.
Air fry at 200°C for 12–14 min, shaking halfway.
Grate ⅓ of the cucumber, squeeze dry, mix with yoghurt, dill and the rest of the lemon juice.
Dice the remaining cucumber, tomatoes and onion.
Warm the pittas 2 min in the air fryer and fill.

recipes.name: Beef & lentil ragù with wholewheat pasta
ingredients: 1 onion, 2 carrots, 2 celery sticks, finely chopped
2 × 400 g crushed tomatoes, 1 tbsp tomato purée
2 dl water, 2 tsp dried oregano, 1 tsp dried thyme, 1 bay leaf
steps: Brown the mince in a little oil, 5 min.
Add onion, carrot and celery; cook 5 min.
Stir in purée, lentils, tomatoes, water and herbs. Simmer 25 min, lid ajar.
Cook the pasta meanwhile.
Serve; parmesan and salt on the table.
recipes.note: Freezes well — good candidate for a future freezer buffer.

recipes.name: Chicken, chickpea & sweet potato curry
ingredients: 2 onions, chopped; 3 cm ginger, grated; pinch of asafoetida (hing)
2 tsp ground cumin, 1 tsp turmeric, 1 tsp mild paprika, ½ tsp cinnamon
400 g crushed tomatoes, 400 ml coconut milk, 2 dl water
1 can chickpeas, rinsed; 100 g baby spinach
steps: Soften onion in oil, 5 min. Add ginger, hing and spices; 1 min.
Add chicken; 3 min.
Add sweet potato, tomatoes, coconut milk and water. Simmer 20 min.
Stir in chickpeas and spinach; 3 min. Squeeze in lemon.
Cook bulgur meanwhile.

recipes.name: Lemon-dill cod with crispy potatoes & peas
steps: Toss potatoes with oil and paprika. Air fry at 200°C for 20 min, shaking twice.
Pat cod dry, brush with oil, top with lemon zest, chopped dill and panko.
Air fry the cod in the second air fryer at 190°C for 10–12 min.
Boil peas 3 min. Mix yoghurt with dill and lemon juice.

recipes.name: White bean & barley minestrone
ingredients: 400 g crushed tomatoes, 1 l water or unsalted stock
1 tsp dried oregano, 1 tsp dried thyme, 1 bay leaf
Parmesan and wholegrain rye bread to serve
steps: Soften onion, carrot and celery in oil, 5 min.
Add tomatoes, water, barley and herbs. Simmer 20 min.
Add courgette, beans and kale. Simmer 8 min.
Squeeze in lemon. Parmesan and bread on the table.

recipes.name: Ginger-sesame chicken with broccoli & noodles
ingredients: 700 g chicken thigh fillets, in strips
2 tbsp sesame oil, 1 tbsp low-salt soy, 1 lime
steps: Toss chicken with ginger, cornflour and 1 tbsp sesame oil.
Air fry at 200°C for 12 min, shaking halfway.
Air fry broccoli and pepper in the second air fryer at 200°C for 8 min.
Cook noodles; toss with soy, remaining sesame oil and lime juice.
Combine; top with spring onion and sesame seeds. Extra soy or chilli for the adults.

recipes.name: Fish fingers, wedges & apple slaw
ingredients: 600 g potatoes, in wedges; 1 tbsp oil; 1 tsp paprika
steps: Toss wedges with oil and paprika. Air fry at 200°C for 20 min, shaking twice.
Fish fingers in the second air fryer at 200°C for 10 min.
Shred cabbage, carrot and apple; mix with yoghurt and lemon juice.
